name: Karen
source:
One of the traditional and trusted players (Kaito).
It seems that she is the third generation.

Using many subordinates, I will take away the treasure in a way that seems to be somewhat pushy.

The treasure you aim for seems to be random, but there may be a law.

"For your master, I will collect treasures from all over the world."

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140302032444/http://shchara.co.jp/04develop/out/2chara.htm#charatop] official site[/url]]
